description: Build a buy preview (curve, or the PancakeSwap pool once graduated; a gangswap token: its GangSwap pool). Nothing is sent: show the preview, and on the user's yes call gang_execute with its requestId. amount = what to pay, in the token's quote.

cdUncounted.description: Pool buy of a token with a countdown reward: buy through its module even if the buy would not count (only when the user wants that)

from.description: With handoff: the user's own wallet (checks it may trade, its balance, and puts it in the link)

handoff.description: Hand the trade to the user's own wallet: returns a prefilled gang.fun link and its QR (qr) for them to open in the wallet app's browser; nothing is signed here. Open agent-window curve tokens only

noPromoter.description: With follow: don't bind the note's author as promoter

note.description: Public, permanent reason for the trade (1-280 chars, no links). Mainnet curve trades only

payBnb.description: Pool buy of a token quoted in another token: pay BNB (BNB -> quote -> token)

promoter.description: Promoter of a token made with --promote: binds this wallet to it for good, on its first buy of the token, on the curve. Only the promoter the user gave

ref.description: Who invited this wallet (0x address or .ai handle), only one the user gave: counts on its first Gang trade

revealAfter.description: Seal the note for 1-72 hours, e.g. "6h"

testnet.description: BSC testnet GangLaunchpad (tokens have no value)

useQuote.description: Pool buy of a WBNB-quoted token (PancakeSwap or GangSwap): pay WBNB

useWbnb.description: Curve buy of a WBNB-quoted token: pay WBNB instead of BNB

name: gang_buy
title: Preview a buy
